- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (sentiment > 0.5) — reduce forecast by 5–10% for consecutive positive sentiment.
- Underestimate prices after strong downward spikes — add 3–5% buffer to forecast if sentiment turns neutral or mildly positive.
- Overshoots after recent price peaks — cap forecast at 10–15% below peak if sentiment is weak or mixed.
- Mean-reversion bias: if forecast is >10% above recent 5-day average, adjust downward by 2–4% if sentiment is low or negative.
- Lagged overreaction: if forecast is >10% above true outcome 3–5 days prior, reduce current forecast by 3–5% to avoid momentum overcorrection.
- Horizon-specific: for 30-day forecasts, reduce forecast by 2–5% if sentiment is consistently low or negative over last 7 days.
